description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Revenue Protection Order No.06/2023 The Customs Ordinance.
reasoning: This gazette content is a notification under the Customs Ordinance, specifically Revenue Protection Order No. 06/2023. It contains a parliamentary resolution that modifies import duty rates under the Sri Lanka-Singapore Free Trade Agreement and rescinds a previous order. This constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement related to customs and trade regulations, fitting the definition of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5).
